lines.trans: Are you saying Mr Wang Er tampered with that song to frame us? That's impossible!
You still call him your mentor? Do you even know why Wang Er got fired last year?
Bu Xiaogu, don't tell me you still think our boss ousted him over petty office politics!
During last year's Twelve Singers wildcard round, Wang Er was the traitor who leaked our artist lineup to our rival!
Only after we caught rock-solid evidence did the chairwoman fire him.
Of course I remember, except back then I thought Ji Xiu at Fentuan Tech leaked the plan.
Ji Xiu? Let me tell you, she is the tightest-lipped woman in the entire country!
Wang Er didn't leak secrets just once; he acted like an informant feeding intel to our competitors for years.
Our boss wanted to root out that rot for ages and used a double trap last year to catch him red-handed.
As Wang Er's intern, not getting swept out of Xingtian alongside him was already huge luck for you.
Right now you need to think back carefully on whether you ever handled that contract for Wang Er last year.
